name: signup-page
description: Public customer signup page: email verification -> licensing customer -> POST /signup (amfa-482). Written by aPersona; served by SignupPageStack.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild ./src/index.mjs --bundle --minify --sourcemap --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --external:@aws-sdk/* --outdir=dist/app --out-extension:.js=.mjs && cp -R public dist/public
